column1: # Certificate references recovered from the discontinued, never-approved CoQ drafts in
# PROVENANCE AND LIMITS — read before using any of this.
# These drafts were never approved and are not evidence of a result. Only three fields are
# taken from them: the external CoA identifier, its date, and the issuing laboratory. Every
# analytical value in those drafts is deliberately left behind — an unapproved document
# cannot supply a result to a quality register, and the register's rule is that a value
# comes off the certificate itself or it does not exist.
# What this file is for: it proves the safety-panel testing was performed for batches the
# register shows as untested, and it names the exact documents to retrieve. It is a
# retrieval list, not a data source.
# Every reference below is transcribed as printed in the draft, including the malformed
# ones. Suspected errors are recorded in the `note` column and are NOT corrected here.
# batch                cultivation batch as printed in the draft's BATCHNUMBER field
# scope                which parameters that laboratory covered, per the draft
# institution          laboratory as named in the draft
# coa_code             external CoA identifier(s) as printed
# in_register          whether the register already holds that code
# note                 transcription concerns; never a correction
